column1: 22659§estimate§ˈestɪmeɪt§v. 估计，估量；估价；评价[ˈestɪmət] n. 估计，估量；估价；评价§The deal is estimated to be worth around £1.5 million.§这笔交易估计价值150万英镑左右。

22660§livelihood§ˈlaɪvlihʊd§n. 生活，生计§We understand a port as a centre of land-sea exchange, and as a major source of livelihood and a major force for cultural mixing.§我们把港口理解为一个海陆交流的中心，生活的重要资源，文化融合的主要推动力量。
22661§manufacture§ˌmænjuˈfæktʃə(r)§vt. 大量制造，成批生产 n. 大量制造；工业品§Many automobile makers no longer manufacture cheap models.§很多汽车制造商不再大量生产低价位车型。
22662§censure§ˈsenʃə(r)§vt./n. 指责，谴责，责难§The warden censured the guard for letting the prisoner escape.§监狱长责骂狱警让罪犯逃走了。
22663§voltage§ˈvəʊltɪdʒ§n. 电压§The voltage made her hair shoot straight out.§电压使得她的头发竖了起来。
22664§logic§ˈlɒdʒɪk§n. 逻辑；逻辑学§Miranda holds the belief that science and logic will unlock the mysteries of the plague.§米兰达坚信科学和逻辑会解开这场瘟疫的未解之谜。
22665§enroll§ɪnˈrəʊl§v. 入学，登记；加入；招收§Places are available here even for students enrolled in the minimum length course.§这里甚至为那些报名参加最短课时的学生提供上课场所。
22666§civilization§ˌsɪvəlaɪˈzeɪʃn§n. 文明；文明社会§Many important civilizations developed from Asia.§许多重要的文明发源于亚洲。
22667§compendium§kəmˈpendiəm§n. 简要，概略§The human genome is the compendium of all these inherited genetic instructions.§人类基因组是所有这些遗传基因说明的一个缩影。
22668§embark§ɪmˈbɑːk§v. （使）上船或飞机；（使）从事§Without hesitation Alexander embarked on his new career as a musician.§亚历山大毫不犹豫地开始了他的新职业，成为一名音乐家。
22669§deserve§dɪˈzɜːv§v. 应得；值得§These poor people deserve our help.§这些可怜的人值得我们帮助。
22670§eject§ɪˈdʒekt§v. 弹出；喷出；驱逐，逐出§The quantity of dust ejected by Mount St. Helens amounted to a quarter of a cubic mile.§圣海伦斯火山喷出的粉尘多达四分之一立方英里。
22671§verification§ˌverɪfɪˈkeɪʃn§n. 确认，证实，核实§The customs will make a verification whether there is record filing before the goods release.§在货物放行之前，海关会先确认一下该批货物是否有备案。
22672§autoimmune§ˌɔːtəʊɪˈmjuːn§adj. 自身免疫的§Once this immune tolerance break down, the immune system would attack its own tissue, and cause autoimmune diseases.§一旦这种免疫耐受受到损害，免疫系统就会攻击自身的组织，引发自身免疫疾病。
22673§inheritance§ɪnˈherɪtəns§n. 遗传；继承，继承物；遗产，遗赠§To get rid of being called “NEET Group”, he is too stubborn to accept the inheri- tance from his father.§为了摆脱“啃老族”的称号，他固执地拒绝接受父亲的遗产。
22674§relentless§rɪˈlentləs§adj. 无情的，残酷的；坚韧的，不屈不挠的§Relentless in his pursuit of quality, his technical ability was remarkable.§由于对质量的坚持不懈的追求，他的技术能力非同凡响。
22675§requisite§ˈrekwɪzɪt§adj. 必需的；必备的；必不可少的 n. 必需品；要素§The keyboard is a requisite hardware device of a computer, also a dialogue tool between a man and a computer.§键盘是计算机必要的硬件设备，也是人与计算机对话的工具。
22676§dizziness§ˈdɪzinəs§n. 头昏眼花，眩晕§With a sudden dizziness, he fell down the floor, which frightened his family.§突然一阵眩晕，他跌倒在地上，把他的家人吓坏了。
22677§periphery§pəˈrɪfəri§n. 不重要的部分；外围§Ideas on this matter are also expressed by some scholars on the periphery of education area.§教育领域外的一些学者也对此发表了看法。
22678§credential§krəˈdenʃl§n. 证明书；（学历、资历）资格证书；证件§Refused by the enterprise again, she was so upset that she tore up these credential documents by hand.§再次被企业拒之门外，她极其沮丧，随手将这些资格证书撕了个粉碎。
22679§facsimile§fækˈsɪməli§n. 复制品；副本§The painting is a facsimile edition that is not so valuable.§这幅画是复制品，不是很值钱。
22680§reel§riːl§n. 卷轴，卷筒，线轴 v. 摇摇晃晃地移动，蹒跚；眩晕，发昏；卷，绕§There are another three new reels of film for use.§还有三卷新胶卷可以使用。
22681§churn§tʃɜːn§n. （制作黄油用的）搅乳器 v. 剧烈搅动；（使）猛烈翻滚；反胃，恶心§The butter churn have two paddles to whip the cream.§黄油搅乳器有两根搅棍用来搅打奶油。
22682§nocturnal§nɒkˈtɜːnl§adj. 夜晚的；夜晚发生的；夜晚活动的§It is probable that the nocturnal trades go way back in the ancestry of all mammals.§夜间进行活动可能是所有哺乳动物自祖先时起就有的行为。

22683§obstruct§əbˈstrʌkt§v. 妨碍，阻止；阻塞；截断§Fish and dolphins that live in extremely muddy water cannot see because, although there is light, it is obstructed and scattered by the dirt in the water.§生活在极其浑浊的水域里的鱼和海豚是看不见东西的，因为尽管有光，但水里的污垢阻塞和分散了光线。
22684§prohibitive§prəˈhɪbətɪv§adj. 禁止的，抑制的；令人望而却步的§This doesn't require a prohibitive amount of energy.§这并不要求具有强大的能量。

22685§navigation§ˌnævɪˈgeɪʃn§n. 航海，航行；导航，领航§All the world now knows that bats, or rather natural selection working on bats, had perfected the system tens of millions of years earlier, and their radar achieves feats of detection and navigation that would strike an engineer dumb with admiration.§现在人们意识到，确切地说因为自然选择的作用，蝙蝠早在几千万年前就已经完善了它们的雷达系统，其在探测与导航方面的成功让工程师们赞叹不已。
22686§entwine§ɪnˈtwaɪn§vt. 使缠住，使盘绕；与…密切相关§The history of human civilization is entwined with the history of the ways we have learned to manipulate water resources.§人类文明的历史与人类学习利用水资源的历程是相互交织在一起的。

22687§monumental§ˌmɒnjuˈmentl§adj. 纪念碑的，纪念物的；不朽的，有重大意义的§Unprecedented construction of tens of thousands of monumental engineering projects have been done to control floods in the country.§该国史无前例地建造了成千上万的重要工程来控制水患。

22688§reiterate§riˈɪtəreɪt§vt. 重复，反复；反复地说，重申§As the United Nations report on access to water reiterated in November 2001, more than one billion people lack access to clean drinking water.§2001年11月联合国关于获取水资源的报告重申了一个事实，即10亿多人口无法获取纯净的饮用水。
22689§peripheral§pəˈrɪfərəl§adj. 外围的；次要的，附带的 n. 外围设备§If we think of a book we studied months or years ago, we will find it easier to recall peripheral details.§当我们回想几个月或几年前读过的一本书时，我们更容易记起一些细枝末节。
22690§jeopardise§ˈdʒepədaɪz§vt. 危害，使受危困§He has never done anything to jeopardise his family.§他从来没有做过任何伤害其家庭的事情。

22691§elusive§ɪˈluːsɪv§adj. 难懂的，难捉摸的；易忘的§Even if these peripheral details are a bit elusive, they come back readily in hypnosis or when we relive the event imaginatively, as in psychodrama.§即使这些细枝末节有点容易忘却，但它们也会在我们处于催眠状态下或者重温往事时在脑海里生动地浮现出来，就像在心理剧里那样。

22692§distinctive§dɪˈstɪŋktɪv§adj. 出众的；有特色的§If you require any further information regarding the convention, you can talk to one of the many convention helpers wearing a distinctive blue and gold jackets.§如果你想获得更多关于本次会议的信息，可以询问大会工作人员，他们穿着显眼的金蓝相间的夹克。
22693§board§bɔːd§n. 板；委员会；（旅馆、招待所等提供的）伙食，膳食§All ceilings will require double-thickness plaster board to be used in the construction.§在建造过程中，所有天花板都需要使用双层厚的灰泥板。

22694§decompression§ˌdiːkəmˈpreʃn§n. 减压；卸压§A manifestation of decompression sickness that is caused by the formation of nitrogen bubbles in the blood and tissues after a rapid reduction in the surrounding pressure is characterized by pain in the joints and abdomen.§减压病是因周围压力急剧减少，在血液和组织中形成氮气泡而引发的一种疾病，其症状表现为关节和腹部疼痛。

22695§prevalent§ˈprevələnt§adj. 流行的，普遍的§It's no surprise that high-profile athletes can influence children's eating behaviours, but the scientists are able to quantify how prevalent these endorsements are in the children's environment.§高知名度的运动员可以影响儿童的饮食行为，这并不奇怪，但科学家能够量化这些代言在儿童环境中的流行程度。
22696§twist§twɪst§v. 缠绕；使扭曲，使弯曲；拧 n. 扭动，转动；转折，转变§Research shows that spasms can cause twisting of the spine.§研究显示，痉挛会导致脊椎扭曲。
22697§rent§rent§v. 租借；出租 n. 租金§This house rents for RMB 5,000 a month.§这房子月租5,000人民币。
22698§eminent§ˈemɪnənt§adj. 杰出的，显赫的§He was then the most eminent architect in England.§他是当时英格兰最著名的建筑师。
22699§crescent§ˈkresnt§n. 新月，月牙；新月形（物） adj. 新月形的§The crescent of a new moon hung over the mulberry in the yard.§一弯新月高悬于院子里的桑树之上。
22700§calm§kɑːm§adj. 镇静的；平静的 v. （使）平静；（使）镇静§The pilot managed to bring the aircraft and its 50 passengers down safely in the calm waters of the bay.§飞行员成功地将飞机降落在风平浪静的海湾中，确保了50名乘客的安全。
22701§scope§skəʊp§n. 眼界，见识；（活动、影响等的）范围；（发挥能力等的）余地，机会§The scope of the environmental problem facing the world's cities is immense.§世界上的许多城市面临着大范围的环境问题。
22702§cooperate§kəʊˈɒpəreɪt§vi. 合作，协作§It is meaningful for world nations to cooperate with each other.§对世界各国来说，相互合作的意义重大。
22703§applaud§əˈplɔːd§v. （向…）鼓掌，喝彩；称赞§They applaud their favorite comedienne as she comes on the stage.§当他们最喜欢的女喜剧演员登台时，他们鼓掌欢迎。
22704§appraisal§əˈpreɪzl§n. 评估，评价§Susan's appraisal of the writer's work was favorable.§苏珊对这位作家的作品给予了肯定的评价。
22705§allowance§əˈlaʊəns§n. 津贴；允许，容忍§I have a good retirement allowance that will make it easy for me to buy a nice house.§我有一笔丰厚的退休金，买一栋好房子没什么经济上的困难。
22706§heir§eə(r)§n. 继承人§The man murdered the legal heir and disguised himself his victim.§该男子谋杀了合法继承人并冒名顶替。
22707§exploit§ɪkˈsplɔɪt§vt. 剥削，压榨；开发，开拓；利用[ˈeksplɔɪt] n. 英勇行为；功绩§Our company was quick to exploit a money-making opportunity provided by the government.§我们公司很快就抓住了政府提供的赚钱机会。
22708§domestic§dəˈmestɪk§adj. 本国的；家庭的；驯养的，家养的§The evidence we have suggests that domestic trade was greater than external trade at all periods.§我们掌握的证据表明，无论在哪个时期，国内贸易都要比对外贸易发达。
22709§unexpected§ˌʌnɪkˈspektɪd§adj. 想不到的，意外的§Some unexpected difficulties have arisen in his life.§他的生活中出现了一些意想不到的困难。
22710§counsel§ˈkaʊnsl§n. 律师，法律顾问；建议，忠告 v. 商议，劝告§Today's Health Counsel is presented by Paula Clayburg.§今天的健康忠告由波拉·克莱伯格讲解。
22711§sticky§ˈstɪki§adj. 黏性的；（天气）湿热的§My fingers are sticky from that candy bar.§糖块把我的手指弄得黏糊糊的。
22712§competition§ˌkɒmpəˈtɪʃn§n. 竞争；比赛§The workers opened small businesses in direct competition with their former employer.§工人们开办了小型公司，直接和他们以前的雇主竞争。
22713§responsible§rɪˈspɒnsəbl§adj. 负有责任的；有责任感的；可靠的§Smoking, as it is believed, is responsible for 30 percent of all deaths from cancer.§在因癌症导致的死亡中，有30%被认为是由吸烟引起的。
22714§critic§ˈkrɪtɪk§n. 批评家；爱挑剔的人§The coal industry has been targeted by critics as a significant contributor to the greenhouse effect.§煤炭业被评论家指责为造成温室效应的主要原因。
22715§extensive§ɪkˈstensɪv§adj. 广大的，广阔的；广泛的§Extensive underground water resources are available over more than half of Australia's land area.§在澳大利亚，超过一半的地域中广泛分布着可利用的地下水资源。
22716§corridor§ˈkɒrɪdɔː(r)§n. 过道，走廊；狭长地带§You will notice that at the end of each corridor there is another door, but these are fire doors.§你会注意到在每一条走廊的尽头都有另一扇门，但这些是防火门。
22717§imagine§ɪˈmædʒɪn§v. 想象；猜想§The children have no need to imagine anything when they read such books.§孩子们阅读这种书时根本不用发挥想象力。
22718§interact§ˌɪntərˈækt§vi. 相互作用；相互影响§Group work can give employees a chance to interact and to share ideas.§分组工作可以给员工一个相互协作和交流的机会。
22719§starchy§ˈstɑːtʃi§adj. 含淀粉的§You eat too much starchy food.§你吃太多含淀粉的食物了。
22720§trivial§ˈtrɪviəl§adj. 无关紧要的，琐屑的；平庸的，普通的§They think that tourism is a trivial subject.§他们认为旅行是一个无关紧要的主题。
22721§exorbitant§ɪɡˈzɔːbɪtənt§adj. （价格、费用）过高的；过分的，不合理的§Glass as instant curtains is available now, but the cost is exorbitant.§现在玻璃可作为即时窗帘用，但成本过于昂贵。
22722§large-scale§ˌlɑːdʒ ˈskeɪl§adj. 大规模的，大范围的§They invested much money into large-scale industrial development.§他们投入大量金钱发展大规模的工业。
22723§region§ˈriːdʒən§n. 地区；范围§Although the UK is a fairly small country, the geology and climate vary a good deal from region to region.§尽管英国的国土面积很小，但是不同地区间的地况和气候却大相径庭。
22724§alternate§ˈɔːltəneɪt§v. （使）轮流，（使）交替[ɔːlˈtɜːnət] adj. 轮流的；间隔的；交替的§Snow and rain alternated, and it was very cold outside.§外面雨雪交加，非常寒冷。
22725§steer§stɪə(r)§v. 驾驶，行驶；引导§He steered his car very carefully along the narrow mountain roads.§他非常小心地驾车行驶在狭窄的山路上。
22726§bargain§ˈbɑːgən§vi. 讨价还价 n. 协议；交易；便宜货§The employees and the employer reached a bargain.§雇员和老板达成了一项协议。
22727§infection§ɪnˈfekʃn§n. 传染，感染，传播；传染病§Are you taking oral medicines for fungal infections?§你在吃口服药预防真菌感染吗？
22728§conservative§kənˈsɜːvətɪv§adj. 保守的，传统的，守旧的 n. 保守的人§The obstacle to our development has been conservative local authorities.§保守的地方当局一直是我们发展的障碍。
22729§spin§spɪn§v. （使）旋转 n. 旋转§This action spins a series of gears.§这个操作使一连串的齿轮旋转起来。
22730§personnel§ˌpɜːsəˈnel§n. 全体人员，员工§All personnel were asked to participate in the meeting.§此次会议要求全体员工参加。
22731§liver§ˈlɪvə(r)§n. 肝脏；生活者，居住者§Some scientists think that the condition of your liver determines how the perfume will smell on you.§一些科学家认为，人体肝脏的健康状况决定了香水在人身上的味道。
22732§swear§sweə(r)§v. 宣誓，郑重承诺；诅咒§Before giving evidence, you must swear what you're going to say is true.§作证前，你必须宣誓保证所说一切皆属实。

22733§inflammable§ɪnˈflæməbl§adj. 易燃的；易怒的§Impressed by the element's combustibility, several 17th century chemists used it to manufacture fire-lighting devices, but the results were dangerously inflammable.§受这种元素可燃性的启发，17世纪的一些化学家用它来制造点火装置，但这些装置却容易发生危险性的燃烧。
22734§disfigure§dɪsˈfɪɡə(r)§vt. 使毁容，使变丑；损毁…的外形§Buildings here disfigured such a beautiful landscape.§这里的建筑破坏了如此美丽的风景。
22735§surf§sɜːf§v. 冲浪§The rugged west coast beaches were famous for surfing.§蜿蜒曲折的西海岸海滩因适合冲浪而闻名。
